Initial:21:0.text: Trying everything, and already knowing the dog needed a different life

Initial:23:0.text: Awful and a relief, and still a bit ashamed of the relief

Initial:31:1.text: Keeping the dog's bowl without knowing why

Initial:33:0.text: Still waking at her hour with nothing to get up for

Initial:33:1.text: Glad of her photos, and needing to put them face down for a bit

quoted.Initial:37:0: "I think I'd want to know first whether I failed her or whether I did the right thing for her, and I don't know that, and I'm not sure anyone can tell me."
quoted.Initial:23:0: "Awful. And a relief. Both at once, and I was ashamed of the relief, I still am a bit."
quoted.Initial:11:0: "That's the strange bit. … I was halfway across before I thought, what are you doing, you haven't got a dog. My body was still doing it for her."
quoted.Initial:5:1: "But the other way is that she took over. Everything had to be arranged round her. Every single thing. And I didn't see it happening until it had already happened."
